title: Check if All Characters Have Equal Number of Occurrences
summary: Determine if a string is good by checking if all characters have the same frequency of occurrences.
statement: Determine if a string is good by checking if all characters have the same frequency of occurrences.
constraints: s has 1 through 1000 lowercase English letters.
Compare only characters that actually occur in s.
Return true exactly when all occurring characters have the same frequency.
reference_solution:
def equal_character_frequencies(s):
    from collections import Counter
    frequencies = set(Counter(s).values())
    return len(frequencies) == 1
known_wrong_solutions:
def equal_character_frequencies(s):
    from collections import Counter
    frequencies = set(Counter(s).values())
    return len(frequencies) <= 2
def equal_character_frequencies(s):
    from collections import Counter
    frequencies = set(Counter(s))
    return len(frequencies) == 1
hints: The actual character identities do not matter after their frequencies are counted.
Build a frequency map and ask whether its values contain exactly one distinct amount.
Every occurring character contributes one count; one distinct count means all are equal, while two distinct counts exhibit a mismatch.
